paragraphs.en: "Borrowed it, Professor Dumbledore, sir," said the giant, climbing carefully off the motorcycle as he spoke. "Young Sirius Black lent it to me. I've got him, sir."
paragraphs.zh: "借的，邓布利多教授，先生，"巨人一边说一边小心地从车上下来，"年轻的西里斯·布莱克借给我的。我接到他了，先生。"

paragraphs.en_html: "No problems, were there?"
paragraphs.en: "No problems, were there?"
paragraphs.zh: "没出什么岔子吧？"

paragraphs.en_html: "No, sir — house was almost destroyed, but I got him out all right before the Muggles started swarmin' around. He fell asleep as we was flyin' over Bristol."
paragraphs.en: "No, sir — house was almost destroyed, but I got him out all right before the Muggles started swarmin' around. He fell asleep as we was flyin' over Bristol."
paragraphs.zh: "没有，先生——房子几乎全毁了，不过我在麻瓜们围过来之前就把他救出来了。我们飞过布里斯托尔的时候他睡着了。"

paragraphs.en_html: Dumbledore and Professor McGonagall bent forward over the bundle of blankets. Inside, just visible, was a baby boy, fast asleep. Under a tuft of jet-black hair over his forehead they could see a curiously shaped cut, like a bolt of lightning.
paragraphs.en: Dumbledore and Professor McGonagall bent forward over the bundle of blankets. Inside, just visible, was a baby boy, fast asleep. Under a tuft of jet-black hair over his forehead they could see a curiously shaped cut, like a bolt of lightning.
paragraphs.zh: 邓布利多和麦格教授俯身去看那捆毯子。里面隐约可见一个男婴，睡得正香。他额前一撮乌黑的头发下面，有一道形状古怪的伤口，像一道闪电。

paragraphs.en_html: "Is that where — ?" whispered Professor McGonagall.
paragraphs.en: "Is that where — ?" whispered Professor McGonagall.
paragraphs.zh: "就是那儿——？"麦格教授低声问。

paragraphs.en_html: "Yes," said Dumbledore. "He'll have that scar forever."
paragraphs.en: "Yes," said Dumbledore. "He'll have that scar forever."
paragraphs.zh: "是的，"邓布利多说，"这道疤他会带一辈子。"

paragraphs.en_html: "Couldn't you do something about it, Dumbledore?"
paragraphs.en: "Couldn't you do something about it, Dumbledore?"
paragraphs.zh: "你不能处理一下吗，邓布利多？"

paragraphs.en_html: "Even if I could, I wouldn't. Scars can come in handy. I have one myself above my left knee that is a perfect map of the London Underground. Well — give him here, Hagrid — we'd better get this over with."
paragraphs.en: "Even if I could, I wouldn't. Scars can come in handy. I have one myself above my left knee that is a perfect map of the London Underground. Well — give him here, Hagrid — we'd better get this over with."
paragraphs.zh: "就算能，我也不会。伤疤有时候能派上用场。我自己左膝上方就有一道，是一幅完美的伦敦地铁图。好了——把他给我，海格——我们还是把这事了结了吧。"

vocabulary.example: said Dumbledore firmly 邓布利多坚定地说
vocabulary.memory: 和 01 节的 firm（公司）同形不同义——这里回到形容词"坚定的"。同一个词在文中出现两次、意思差很远，这正是"语境定词义"的最好例证。

vocabulary.example: repeated Professor McGonagall faintly 麦格教授有气无力地重复道
vocabulary.memory: faint 三个常用义：微弱的（a faint sound）、模糊的（a faint memory）、昏倒（faint）。这里取"无力"。

vocabulary.example: He'll be famous — a legend . 他会出名——成为传奇。
vocabulary.memory: 词族：legend（传说）→ legendary（传奇的）。口语里 He's a legend!＝他真是个神人！

vocabulary.meaning: 使某人飘飘然、冲昏头脑
vocabulary.example: enough to turn any boy's head 足以让任何男孩冲昏头脑
vocabulary.memory: 字面"把头转过去"→ 注意力被名利勾走。常与 fame、praise、success 搭配。

vocabulary.example: changed her mind, swallowed , and then said… 改了主意，咽了口口水，然后说……
vocabulary.memory: 这里不是"吞东西"，而是"咽口水"——紧张/犹豫的身体语言。同义：gulp（大口吞）。

vocabulary.example: said Professor McGonagall grudgingly 麦格教授不情愿地说
vocabulary.memory: grudge＝怨恨、不情愿。grudging praise＝勉勉强强的夸奖。同义：reluctantly。

vocabulary.example: you can't pretend he's not careless 你不能假装他不粗心
vocabulary.memory: care + -less（无）→ 不上心的。反义：careful。同类后缀：hopeless、fearless、speechless。

vocabulary.example: He does tend to — 他确实容易——
vocabulary.memory: do/does 在这里是强调："他确实容易……"。tend to 描述习惯性倾向，比 usually 更书面。

vocabulary.example: A low rumbling sound 一阵低沉的隆隆声
vocabulary.memory: 拟声词，雷、卡车、肚子饿都能 rumble。同族：rumble of thunder（雷声隆隆）、My stomach rumbled.（我肚子咕咕叫。）

vocabulary.example: some sign of a headlight 车灯的迹象
vocabulary.memory: head + light。车辆灯光全套：headlight 前灯、taillight 尾灯、indicator 转向灯、hazard lights 双闪。

vocabulary.example: it swelled to a roar 声音涨成了轰鸣
vocabulary.memory: 原义"肿胀"→ 声音由小变大。反义：fade、die down（渐弱）。名词 a swell 还可指"涌浪"。

vocabulary.example: swelled to a roar 涨成一片轰鸣
vocabulary.memory: 狮吼、引擎轰鸣、人群欢呼都用 roar。搭配：roar with laughter（哈哈大笑）。

vocabulary.example: the man sitting astride it 跨坐在车上的那个男人
vocabulary.memory: a-（在……上）+ stride（跨步）→ 跨着。骑马、骑车、骑摩托的"跨坐"都用它。

vocabulary.example: long tangles of hair 一团团乱缠的头发
vocabulary.memory: 耳机线打结就是 tangle。反义：untangle（解开）。比喻：be tangled in sth（被缠进某事）。

vocabulary.example: bushy black hair 浓密的黑发
vocabulary.memory: bush（灌木丛）+ -y → 像灌木一样密。固定搭配：bushy eyebrows（浓眉）、a bushy beard（浓密的胡子）。

vocabulary.example: hands the size of trash can lids 手有垃圾桶盖那么大
vocabulary.memory: 美式 trash can = 英式 dustbin / rubbish bin。lid 是"盖子"（pot lid 锅盖、eyelid 眼皮）。

vocabulary.example: feet like baby dolphins 脚像小海豚
vocabulary.memory: 罗琳式的奇喻：巨人的大脚被比作"小海豚"，既写尺寸又写圆润。比喻句写作可借鉴这种"反差喻"。

vocabulary.example: his vast, muscular arms 他那粗壮多肉的手臂
vocabulary.memory: muscle（肌肉）+ -ar。形容体型的词串：muscular 健壮、slim 苗条、stout 壮硕、lean 精瘦。

vocabulary.example: a bundle of blankets 一捆毯子
vocabulary.memory: 短语：a bundle of nerves（极度紧张的人）、bundle up（穿得严严实实）。这里"一捆毯子"就是襁褓。

vocabulary.example: said Dumbledore, sounding relieved 邓布利多说，听上去松了口气
vocabulary.memory: relieve（减轻）→ relieved（感到宽慰）。搭配：be relieved to hear that… / a sigh of relief（松了口气）。

vocabulary.example: the Muggles started swarmin' around 麻瓜们开始围过来
vocabulary.memory: swarm 原指蜂群。海格说话带口音，swarming 写成 swarmin'，flying 写成 flyin'——原文用拼写表现方言，读时注意这是"口音"不是错字。

vocabulary.meaning: 弯腰；俯身 （bent 是过去式）
vocabulary.example: bent forward over the bundle 俯身看那捆毯子
vocabulary.memory: 不规则：bend - bent - bent。搭配：bend down（弯腰）、bend over（俯身）、bend the rules（变通规则）。

vocabulary.example: a tuft of jet-black hair 一撮乌黑的头发
vocabulary.memory: 量词，专用于"丛生的毛发/草"。同类：a lock of hair（一缕）、a strand（一根）、a wisp（一丝）。

vocabulary.example: a tuft of jet-black hair 一撮乌黑的头发
vocabulary.memory: jet＝黑玉（一种黑色宝石）。颜色 + 名词构成的形容词：jet-black、snow-white、blood-red、sky-blue。

vocabulary.example: a curiously shaped cut 一道形状古怪的伤口
vocabulary.memory: curious 双义：好奇的 / 奇怪的。这里修饰 shaped，取"古怪"。同族：curiosity（好奇心）。

vocabulary.example: like a bolt of lightning 像一道闪电
vocabulary.memory: 闪电的固定量词是 bolt（一道）。同类：a flash of lightning（一闪）、a clap of thunder（一声雷）。

vocabulary.example: He'll have that scar forever. 这道疤他会带一辈子。
vocabulary.memory: 全书的"关键道具"在此登场。搭配：leave a scar（留下疤痕）、a scar on one's face。

vocabulary.example: Scars can come in handy . 伤疤有时能派上用场。
vocabulary.memory: handy＝方便的、顺手的。同义：be useful、prove useful。不可数，不能说 a handy。

vocabulary.meaning: 把（不愉快的）事赶紧了结
vocabulary.example: we'd better get this over with 我们还是把这事了结了吧
vocabulary.memory: over＝结束。暗含"这事不情愿，但必须做，快点做完"。同义：get it done、finish it off。

paragraphs.en_html: Dumbledore took Harry in his arms and turned toward the Dursleys' house.
paragraphs.en: Dumbledore took Harry in his arms and turned toward the Dursleys' house.
paragraphs.zh: 邓布利多把哈利抱进怀里，转身朝德思礼家走去。

paragraphs.en_html: "Could I — could I say good-bye to him, sir?" asked Hagrid. He bent his great, shaggy head over Harry and gave him what must have been a very scratchy, whiskery kiss. Then, suddenly, Hagrid let out a howl like a wounded dog.
paragraphs.en: "Could I — could I say good-bye to him, sir?" asked Hagrid. He bent his great, shaggy head over Harry and gave him what must have been a very scratchy, whiskery kiss. Then, suddenly, Hagrid let out a howl like a wounded dog.
paragraphs.zh: "我能——我能跟他道个别吗，先生？"海格问。他低下那颗蓬乱的大脑袋凑近哈利，给了他一个想必又扎人、又满是胡茬的吻。紧接着，海格突然像条受伤的狗一样，发出一声长嚎。

paragraphs.en_html: "Shhh!" hissed Professor McGonagall, "you'll wake the Muggles!"
paragraphs.en: "Shhh!" hissed Professor McGonagall, "you'll wake the Muggles!"
paragraphs.zh: "嘘！"麦格教授嘶声道，"你会把麻瓜吵醒的！"

paragraphs.en_html: "S-s-sorry," sobbed Hagrid, taking out a large, spotted handkerchief and burying his face in it. "But I c-c-can't stand it — Lily an' James dead — an' poor little Harry off ter live with Muggles —"
paragraphs.en: "S-s-sorry," sobbed Hagrid, taking out a large, spotted handkerchief and burying his face in it. "But I c-c-can't stand it — Lily an' James dead — an' poor little Harry off ter live with Muggles —"
paragraphs.zh: "对、对、对不起，"海格抽泣着，掏出一块带圆点的大手帕，把脸埋了进去。"可我受、受不了——莉莉和詹姆斯死了——可怜的小哈利还要去跟麻瓜住——"

paragraphs.en_html: "Yes, yes, it's all very sad, but get a grip on yourself, Hagrid, or we'll be found," Professor McGonagall whispered, patting Hagrid gingerly on the arm as Dumbledore stepped over the low garden wall and walked to the front door. He laid Harry gently on the doorstep, took a letter out of his cloak, tucked it inside Harry's blankets, and then came back to the other two. For a full minute the three of them stood and looked at the little bundle; Hagrid's shoulders shook, Professor McGonagall blinked furiously, and the twinkling light that usually shone from Dumbledore's eyes seemed to have gone out.
paragraphs.en: "Yes, yes, it's all very sad, but get a grip on yourself, Hagrid, or we'll be found," Professor McGonagall whispered, patting Hagrid gingerly on the arm as Dumbledore stepped over the low garden wall and walked to the front door. He laid Harry gently on the doorstep, took a letter out of his cloak, tucked it inside Harry's blankets, and then came back to the other two. For a full minute the three of them stood and looked at the little bundle; Hagrid's shoulders shook, Professor McGonagall blinked furiously, and the twinkling light that usually shone from Dumbledore's eyes seemed to have gone out.
paragraphs.zh: "好了好了，这确实很伤心，可你得控制住自己，海格，不然我们会被发现的，"麦格教授低声说，一边小心翼翼地拍拍他的手臂。邓布利多跨过矮矮的花园围墙，走向前门。他把哈利轻轻放在门阶上，从斗篷里取出一封信，塞进哈利的毯子里，然后回到另外两人身边。整整一分钟，三个人站在那里，看着那小小的襁褓；海格的肩膀在发抖，麦格教授拼命眨着眼，而邓布利多眼里惯有的那种闪烁的光，似乎熄灭了。

paragraphs.en_html: "Well," said Dumbledore finally, "that's that. We've no business staying here. We may as well go and join the celebrations."
paragraphs.en: "Well," said Dumbledore finally, "that's that. We've no business staying here. We may as well go and join the celebrations."
paragraphs.zh: "好了，"邓布利多终于说，"就这样吧。我们没理由再待在这儿了。不如去参加庆祝吧。"

paragraphs.en_html: "Yeah," said Hagrid in a very muffled voice, "I'd best get this bike away. G'night, Professor McGonagall — Professor Dumbledore, sir."
paragraphs.en: "Yeah," said Hagrid in a very muffled voice, "I'd best get this bike away. G'night, Professor McGonagall — Professor Dumbledore, sir."
paragraphs.zh: "嗯，"海格用闷闷的声音说，"我最好把这车弄走。晚安，麦格教授——邓布利多教授，先生。"

paragraphs.en_html: Wiping his streaming eyes on his jacket sleeve, Hagrid swung himself onto the motorcycle and kicked the engine into life; with a roar it rose into the air and off into the night.
paragraphs.en: Wiping his streaming eyes on his jacket sleeve, Hagrid swung himself onto the motorcycle and kicked the engine into life; with a roar it rose into the air and off into the night.
paragraphs.zh: 海格用夹克袖子擦着止不住的眼泪，翻身跨上摩托车，一脚把引擎踹着了；随着一声轰鸣，车子升上空中，飞进了夜色。

paragraphs.en_html: "I shall see you soon, I expect, Professor McGonagall," said Dumbledore, nodding to her. Professor McGonagall blew her nose in reply.
paragraphs.en: "I shall see you soon, I expect, Professor McGonagall," said Dumbledore, nodding to her. Professor McGonagall blew her nose in reply.
paragraphs.zh: "我想我们很快会再见的，麦格教授，"邓布利多说，朝她点了点头。麦格教授擤了擤鼻子，算是回答。

paragraphs.en_html: Dumbledore turned and walked back down the street. On the corner he stopped and took out the silver Put-Outer. He clicked it once, and twelve balls of light sped back to their street lamps so that Privet Drive glowed suddenly orange and he could make out a tabby cat slinking around the corner at the other end of the street. He could just see the bundle of blankets on the step of number four.
paragraphs.en: Dumbledore turned and walked back down the street. On the corner he stopped and took out the silver Put-Outer. He clicked it once, and twelve balls of light sped back to their street lamps so that Privet Drive glowed suddenly orange and he could make out a tabby cat slinking around the corner at the other end of the street. He could just see the bundle of blankets on the step of number four.
paragraphs.zh: 邓布利多转身沿街往回走。到了街角，他停下，掏出那只银色的熄灯器。他按了一下，十二个光球飞回各自的街灯，女贞路顿时亮起一片橘色的光，他能辨认出街那头一只虎斑猫正悄悄绕过街角。他也勉强看得见四号门阶上那捆毯子。

paragraphs.en_html: "Good luck, Harry," he murmured. He turned on his heel and with a swish of his cloak, he was gone.
paragraphs.en: "Good luck, Harry," he murmured. He turned on his heel and with a swish of his cloak, he was gone.
paragraphs.zh: "祝你好运，哈利，"他低声说。他脚跟一转，斗篷"唰"地一响，人就不见了。

paragraphs.en_html: A breeze ruffled the neat hedges of Privet Drive, which lay silent and tidy under the inky sky, the very last place you would expect astonishing things to happen. Harry Potter rolled over inside his blankets without waking up. One small hand closed on the letter beside him and he slept on, not knowing he was special, not knowing he was famous, not knowing he would be woken in a few hours' time by Mrs. Dursley's scream as she opened the front door to put out the milk bottles, nor that he would spend the next few weeks being prodded and pinched by his cousin Dudley… He couldn't know that at this very moment, people meeting in secret all over the country were holding up their glasses and saying in hushed voices: "To Harry Potter — the boy who lived!"
paragraphs.en: A breeze ruffled the neat hedges of Privet Drive, which lay silent and tidy under the inky sky, the very last place you would expect astonishing things to happen. Harry Potter rolled over inside his blankets without waking up. One small hand closed on the letter beside him and he slept on, not knowing he was special, not knowing he was famous, not knowing he would be woken in a few hours' time by Mrs. Dursley's scream as she opened the front door to put out the milk bottles, nor that he would spend the next few weeks being prodded and pinched by his cousin Dudley… He couldn't know that at this very moment, people meeting in secret all over the country were holding up their glasses and saying in hushed voices: "To Harry Potter — the boy who lived!"
paragraphs.zh: 一阵微风吹皱了女贞路两旁修剪整齐的树篱。这条街在墨黑的天空下沉静而整洁，是全天下你最想不到会发生惊人之事的地方。哈利·波特在毯子里翻了个身，没有醒。一只小手握住了身旁的信，他继续睡着：不知道自己有多么特别，不知道自己已经出名，也不知道再过几个小时，德思礼太太打开前门放牛奶瓶时会尖叫着把他吵醒；更不知道接下来的几个星期里，他会被表哥达力又戳又掐……他不可能知道，就在此刻，全国各地秘密聚会的人们正举起酒杯，压低声音说："为哈利·波特——那个大难不死的男孩——干杯！"

vocabulary.example: his great, shaggy head 他那颗蓬乱的大脑袋
vocabulary.memory: 和 12 节的 bushy 近义，但 shaggy 更强调"长而乱糟糟"。常见搭配：a shaggy dog（毛茸茸的狗）。

vocabulary.example: a very scratchy kiss 一个很扎人的吻
vocabulary.memory: scratch（抓、挠）+ -y。毛衣扎人、胡子扎脸都用它。同族：itchy（发痒的）。

vocabulary.meaning: 长满胡须的；胡茬扎人的
vocabulary.example: a scratchy, whiskery kiss 又扎人又带胡茬的吻
vocabulary.memory: whisker＝胡须（猫的胡须也叫 whisker）。猫的胡须、老人的络腮胡都可用。以 -er 结尾加 -y 变成形容词。

vocabulary.example: Hagrid let out a howl . 海格发出一声长嚎。
vocabulary.memory: 狼、狗、风都可以 howl。搭配：howl with laughter（笑得前仰后合）、howl in pain。

vocabulary.example: "Shhh!" hissed Professor McGonagall. "嘘！"麦格教授嘶声道。
vocabulary.memory: 蛇的"嘶嘶"、蒸汽的"嘶"、人压低嗓子催促都是 hiss。和 whisper 的区别：hiss 带"嘘"的齿音。

vocabulary.example: "S-s-sorry," sobbed Hagrid. "对、对、对不起，"海格抽泣着说。
vocabulary.memory: 哭的层次：cry（哭，最泛）< weep（书面，流泪）< sob（出声抽泣）< wail（号啕）。原文用 S-s-sorry 的断音写出抽泣。

vocabulary.meaning: 有圆点花纹的；有斑点的
vocabulary.example: a large, spotted handkerchief 一块带圆点的大手帕
vocabulary.memory: 图案词一组记：spotted 圆点、striped 条纹、checked 格子、floral 碎花、plain 纯色。

vocabulary.example: burying his face in it 把脸埋进手帕里
vocabulary.memory: bury 本义"埋葬"→ 引申"深深埋进"。搭配：bury one's head in one's hands（双手抱头）、be buried in work（埋头工作）。

vocabulary.meaning: 控制住自己的情绪；镇定下来
vocabulary.example: get a grip on yourself 控制住你自己
vocabulary.memory: grip＝抓紧。和 06 节的 pull oneself together 同义，口语更短更冲。

vocabulary.meaning: 小心翼翼地；轻手轻脚地
vocabulary.example: patting Hagrid gingerly on the arm 小心翼翼地拍他的手臂
vocabulary.memory: 形容动作"怕弄疼对方或怕出错"。同义：cautiously、delicately。麦格教授对海格"小心地拍"——写出她的克制与关心。

vocabulary.example: laid Harry gently on the doorstep 把哈利轻轻放在门阶上
vocabulary.memory: door + step。全章最著名的画面就是"门阶上的婴儿"。相关：doorway（门口）、doormat（门垫）、doorbell（门铃）。

vocabulary.example: in a very muffled voice 用闷闷的声音
vocabulary.memory: muff 本指"暖手筒/捂住"，muffle 是"捂住使声音变闷"。例句：muffled footsteps（闷闷的脚步声）。

vocabulary.example: Wiping his streaming eyes 擦着止不住的眼泪
vocabulary.memory: stream 本义"小溪"，作动词"流成河"。搭配：streaming eyes（泪流满面）、tears streaming down one's face。

vocabulary.meaning: （猛地）转身跨上；摆动 （swung 是过去式）
vocabulary.example: swung himself onto the motorcycle 翻身跨上摩托车
vocabulary.memory: 不规则：swing - swung - swung。搭配：swing one's legs（晃腿）、swing round（猛转身）。

vocabulary.example: Professor McGonagall blew her nose 麦格教授擤了擤鼻子
vocabulary.memory: 哭完之后擤鼻子——作者用这个动作代替"她也哭了"，含蓄。写作技巧：用动作代替情绪陈述。

vocabulary.example: a tabby cat slinking around the corner 一只虎斑猫悄悄绕过街角
vocabulary.memory: 带"偷偷摸摸、不好意思"的色彩。同义：sneak、creep。猫的招牌动作。

vocabulary.example: "Good luck, Harry," he murmured . "祝你好运，哈利，"他低声说。
vocabulary.memory: 音色柔和，常带温柔或隐秘感。三个"低语"的差别：whisper（气声说）、murmur（柔和低语）、mutter（含抱怨的咕哝）。

vocabulary.example: He turned on his heel and was gone. 他脚跟一转，就不见了。
vocabulary.memory: heel＝脚后跟。这个短语写"干脆利落地转身离开"，比 turned around 有画面感。

vocabulary.example: with a swish of his cloak 斗篷"唰"地一响
vocabulary.memory: sw- 家族拟声词：swish（唰）、swoosh（嗖）、swish-swish（裙摆摩擦声）。巫师长袍的标准音效。

vocabulary.example: A breeze ruffled the hedges. 一阵微风吹皱了树篱。
vocabulary.memory: 风的强度：breeze（微风）< wind（风）< gale（大风）< storm（暴风雨）。口语：It's a breeze.（小菜一碟。）

vocabulary.example: A breeze ruffled the neat hedges. 微风吹皱了整齐的树篱。
vocabulary.memory: 和 09 节的 ruffled（慌乱的）同源：先"弄乱"，再"搅乱心情"。一词语义延伸的典型例子。

vocabulary.example: the neat hedges of Privet Drive 女贞路修剪整齐的树篱
vocabulary.memory: 英式住宅区标配。习语：hedge one's bets（两面下注）、sit on the hedge（骑墙）。

vocabulary.example: under the inky sky 在墨黑的天空下
vocabulary.memory: ink（墨水）+ -y → 像墨一样的黑。同义高级表达：pitch-black、jet-black。写作夜景必备。

vocabulary.example: expect astonishing things to happen 期待惊人之事发生
vocabulary.memory: 和 11 节的 astounding 是同义词，本章前后呼应。astonishing 修饰事物，astonished 修饰人。

vocabulary.example: being prodded and pinched 被又戳又捏
vocabulary.memory: 搭配：prod sb into doing sth（催促某人做某事）。和 poke 近义，prod 更用力、更持续。

vocabulary.example: prodded and pinched by his cousin 被表哥又戳又捏
vocabulary.memory: 习语：at a pinch（必要时）、feel the pinch（手头紧）。形容词 pinched 还指"憔悴的"。

vocabulary.example: saying in hushed voices 压低声音说
vocabulary.memory: hush＝"嘘"，作名词是"寂静"，作动词是"使安静"。a hushed voice 特指"因为敬畏或秘密而压低的声音"——正好收束全章的秘密气氛。
